note: The trilogy list is taken from section 5 of design/master-prompt.md. Titles are resolved against the snapshot; a trilogy whose titles are not in the snapshot is skipped, never filled with guesses. 'kind' separates narrative trilogies from thematic and director-defined ones, as the brief requires.

trilogies.name: The Lord of the Rings trilogy
titles: The Lord of the Rings: The Fellowship of the Ring
The Lord of the Rings: The Two Towers
The Lord of the Rings: The Return of the King
trilogies.note: One continuous story filmed as three parts.

trilogies.name: The Dark Knight trilogy
trilogies.note: Christopher Nolan's three Batman films: one continuity, one arc.

trilogies.name: The original Star Wars trilogy
titles: Star Wars: Episode IV – A New Hope
Star Wars: Episode V – The Empire Strikes Back
Star Wars: Episode VI – Return of the Jedi

trilogies.name: The Cornetto Trilogy
trilogies.note: Linked by director Edgar Wright, writers Wright and Simon Pegg, recurring actors and a running ice-cream gag. Not a continuous story.

trilogies.name: The Back to the Future trilogy
titles: Back to the Future Part II
Back to the Future Part III

trilogies.name: The Before trilogy
trilogies.note: Nine-year gaps in the story, the same two lead actors and director.

trilogies.name: The Three Colours trilogy
trilogies.note: Krzysztof Kieślowski's films on the French Revolution's ideals (liberty, equality, fraternity). Thematic, not a continuous story.

trilogies.name: The Dollars Trilogy
titles: The Good, the Bad and the Ugly
trilogies.note: Sergio Leone's films with Clint Eastwood; separate stories, shared style and lead.

trilogies.name: The Vengeance Trilogy
trilogies.note: Park Chan-wook's films about revenge. Thematic, not a continuous story.
